notes.notes: [p][b]Update Log[/b][/p][p][/p][p]1.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the camera would freeze after clearing the Mid-Boss in the stage 3, returning to save, and then reloading the game.[/p]

[p][b]Update Log[/b][/p][p][/p][p]1.[/p][p]We have added ‘NONOSINISO’ and ‘겨울’ to the [b]Special Thanks[/b] section in the credits for helping proofread the Korean dialogue of the released game.[/p][p][/p][p]2.[/p][p]We have added ‘dnamg’ to the [b]Special Thanks[/b] section in the credits for reporting a significant number of bugs in the released game.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely thank you for your interest in the game and for your support.[/p]

[p][b] Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Machine gun – Electric-type attack power reduced by 5%.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] Enemies[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ghosts in an inactive state can no longer be removed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] Effects & Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]When ROT is destroyed, the giant orb it fires will also be destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the post-R key input lock duration by 5 frames.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where speech bubbles wouldn't disappear when moving away from "Memory of the World" revision point.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the exclamation mark wouldn’t disappear after talking to Metia following the Ecaep boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where attacking was possible during the ending.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, if you defeat Ecaep while holding a rapid-fire weapon and the fire button is held down, shots would still fire after Ecaep disappears.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound not stopping when restarting during laser firing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound not stopping when restarting during Ecaep’s magic circle effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound not stopping when restarting during switch activation.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] Convenience[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added "Exit" and "Save" options during Boss Rush mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing the X key on NPC command windows now cancels the selection.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when loading from the main menu using F2, while direct F2 load itself works fine.[/p][/*][/list]
